xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4821: Close-out reports 'no pull request found' when the forge PR read fails transiently (dod-gate maps every lookup error to null)

plan.title: Close-out reports 'no pull request found' when the forge PR read fails transiently (dod-gate maps every lookup error to null)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: DoD rows 1 and 2 map every forge PR read failure to null and report 'no pull request found on the forge for this issue', discarding the real error; a failed read can even be waived by the strike or terminal-settlement paths. fetchIssuePullRequest also caches the error response for up to 60 s, so later readers in the same process see the same failure. Three merged issues failed close-out this way on 2026-11-02 and passed on retry.
narratives.Proposal: Stop caching error responses in fetchIssuePullRequest. Add src/lib/lifecycle/dod-pr-read.ts with readPullRequestWithRetry (2 attempts, 1000 ms pause, console.warn per failed attempt) and a typed PullRequestReadError. Wire DoD rows 1, 2, 4 and 5 through it: rows 1/2 report a failed read as a miss carrying the real error and never skip it; row 4 keeps its 'forge metadata unavailable' text with the new message; row 5 tolerates the failure as an absent mergedAt. Document the new text in MERGE-WORKFLOW.md and the pan-close skill.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new DodRowStatus value; a read failure is a miss
- No change to --accept-* flags or their semantics
- No change to src/lib/github-app.ts or the GitHub quota layer
- No fix for the underlying post-reload trigger (follow-up once the warn line names it)
- No retry inside fetchIssuePullRequest itself; the dashboard PR tab and merge gate keep their behavior apart from not caching errors
- No change to checkVerificationRow's catch on the verification-artifact door
- No single-flight de-duplication of concurrent PR reads in one gate evaluation
- No change to row 5's observed wording when mergedAt is unavailable

autoDecisions.summary: A failed PR read keeps DoD status 'miss' with distinct observed text; no fourth DodRowStatus
autoDecisions.rationale: An unreadable PR must block exactly like a miss and stay overridable with --accept-review/--accept-tests; a new status would ripple into workflows.ts, close.ts renderDodGate, the pan-close skill table and --accept semantics for no behavioral gain. The issue's 'typed unknown/error row' is met by PullRequestReadError plus distinct text.

autoDecisions.summary: A failed read fails closed in rows 1 and 2: no strike skip and no terminal-settlement skip
autoDecisions.rationale: Both waivers reason from 'no PR exists'; a failed read cannot rule out CHANGES_REQUESTED or red checks. Matches readCompletedCloseOut's fail-closed rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Retry once (2 attempts) with a 1000 ms pause
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for one retry; a short pause bounds added latency during a real outage.

autoDecisions.summary: Retry lives in a new src/lib/lifecycle/dod-pr-read.ts, not in fetchIssuePullRequest
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps dashboard PR-tab latency and the merge gate's own reread unchanged; dod-gate.ts is 933/1000 lines so the helper belongs in a sibling file like dod-deploy-probe.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Row 4 also reads through the retrying helper
autoDecisions.rationale: Row 4 reads first; a successful retry is cached and serves rows 1, 2 and 5, and row 4's mergeCommit feeds rows 6 and 8.

autoDecisions.summary: Row 5's mergedAt read returns undefined on PullRequestReadError
autoDecisions.rationale: Row 5's evidence is the canonical state; a missing mergedAt can only turn a pass into a miss, so tolerance cannot wrongly pass the row, while throwing would regress a 'canonical state: done' pass during an outage.

autoDecisions.summary: Log every failed attempt with console.warn prefixed [dod-gate]
autoDecisions.rationale: A successful retry leaves nothing in the row text, so the warn line is the only trace of the post-reload trigger; console.warn is the lifecycle convention and reaches the operator's terminal in the CLI.

items.title: Stop caching failed PR reads in fetchIssuePullRequest

expected_outputs: issue-pr.test.ts passes including the three new PAN-4821 cache tests

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4821.md WI-1. In fetchIssuePullRequest (src/lib/overdeck/pull-requests.ts, grep anchor `setCachedIssuePrTabResponse('pr', issueId, generation, result);`) wrap the cache write in `if (!result.error)` with the PAN-4821 comment from the PRD. Add the three tests named in WI-1 to the existing describe block in tests/unit/dashboard/server/routes/issue-pr.test.ts, using its mockExec child_process mock.

items.title: Given gh pr view rejects on the first fetchIssuePullRequest call, when the same issue is read a second time and gh pr view now resolves, then the second call returns PR 642 with no error and mockExec shows 6 calls in total (the forge was asked again)
Given the first gh pr list probe rejects with ETIMEDOUT, when the issue is read again, then the second call re-probes and returns the PR instead of the cached 'gh pr list failed' error

Given both branch probes return empty output, when fetchIssuePullRequest is called twice, then both calls return pr null with no error and mockExec shows exactly 2 calls (the absent answer is still cached)
Add readPullRequestWithRetry with PullRequestReadError and per-attempt warn lines

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/lib/lifecycle/dod-pr-read.ts exactly as the PRD snippet: PR_READ_ATTEMPTS=2, PR_READ_PAUSE_MS=1000, class PullRequestReadError (issueId, underlying; message `pull request read failed on the forge after 2 attempts: <underlying>`), readPullRequestWithRetry(fetchPr, issueId). A response with `error` or a thrown fetch is a failed attempt; each failed attempt calls console.warn with `[dod-gate] <ISSUE> pull request read failed (attempt n of 2): <error>`. Create tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-pr-read.test.ts with the five tests named in WI-2, using vi.useFakeTimers and vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync (template: dod-deploy-probe.test.ts). No real setTimeout waits in tests.

items.title: Given the first read returns an error response and the second returns PR 42, when readPullRequestWithRetry runs and timers advance 1000 ms, then it resolves to PR 42 after exactly 2 fetches and emits one console.warn line containing 'attempt 1 of 2' and the first error text
Given the forge answers pr null with no error, when readPullRequestWithRetry runs, then it returns null after exactly 1 fetch and emits no warn line

Given every read fails with 'gh pr view failed: timeout', when readPullRequestWithRetry runs, then it rejects with a PullRequestReadError whose message is 'pull request read failed on the forge after 2 attempts: gh pr view failed: timeout' and stops at 2 fetches even after 10 more seconds of fake time
Given the first read fails, when only 999 ms of fake time elapse, then the second fetch has not been issued, and it is issued once the 1000th ms elapses
Report a failed PR read in DoD rows 1 and 2 instead of 'no pull request found'

expected_outputs: file-size guard reports no violation for src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. In src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts: import PullRequestReadError and readPullRequestWithRetry from './dod-pr-read.js'; set defaultDeps.readPullRequest to `issueId => readPullRequestWithRetry(fetchIssuePullRequest, issueId)`; replace the `.catch(() => null)` in checkVerdict with the try/catch from the PRD that returns result(id, 'miss', <error text>) before any strike or terminal-settlement logic; add exported readPullRequestMergedAt (returns undefined on PullRequestReadError) and wire defaultPostMergeRowDeps.readMergedAt to it. Split the existing test at dod-gate.test.ts line 153 into the four tests named in WI-3 (change assertions; never skip or delete). Create tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate-pr-read.test.ts with the four default-wiring tests, mocking fetchIssuePullRequest via vi.mock with importOriginal and using fake timers.

In src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts add exported readMergedRowPullRequest(ctx, branchName) (returns {} without reading when ctx.github is unset; otherwise `(await readPullRequestWithRetry(fetchIssuePullRequest, ctx.issueId)) ?? {}`) and set defaultMergedRowDeps.readPullRequest to it, removing the `if (response.error) throw new Error(response.error)` body. Leave checkMergedRow's catch untouched. Add the three row-4 tests from WI-4 to tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate-pr-read.test.ts.
